args.CodeContent:
# Implementation Plan: UMGN - Secure Personal AI Chatbot Web App UMGN is a production-ready, highly secure personal AI chatbot web application inspired by ChatGPT. It features a modern responsive UI (desktop sidebar + mobile drawer), server-side LLM orchestration with zero API key exposure, user authentication, chat history persistence with a relational database, user data export and deletion compliance, rate limiting, and automated HTTPS cloud deployment configurations. ## User Review Required > [!IMPORTANT] > **API Provider & Fallback:** The backend will support server-side Google Gemini (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) and OpenAI (`OPENAI_API_KEY`) via `.env.local`. If no external API key is provided immediately during local testing, UMGN includes a built-in intelligent fallback assistant engine so you can test and use the app out of the box. > > **Database Architecture:** Built on **Prisma ORM** with SQLite by default for instant zero-dependency local setup (supporting 10–50 users easily). It is architected so switching to PostgreSQL (e.g., Supabase, Neon, AWS RDS) for high-scale multi-user production requires only changing `DATABASE_URL` and `provider = "postgresql"` in `schema.prisma`. --- ## Key Features & Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD Client["Client Browser (Phone / Laptop Responsive)"] subgraph Frontend ["Frontend (Next.js App Router + Tailwind CSS)"] UI["ChatGPT-style UI
(Sidebar, New Chat, Markdown, Code Copy)"] Settings["Settings Modal
(Theme, System Prompt, Export Data, Delete Account)"] end subgraph Security ["Security & Middleware Layer"] RateLimit["Rate Limiting Middleware"] AuthMid["JWT Auth Verification (HttpOnly SameSite Cookie)"] SecHeaders["Security Headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame)"] end subgraph Backend ["Backend API Handlers"] AuthAPI["/api/auth (Register, Login, Logout, Session)"] ChatAPI["/api/chat (Stream LLM Response, Server-Side API Keys)"] HistoryAPI["/api/chats (List, Create, Rename, Delete)"] UserDataAPI["/api/user (Export Data, Clear Chats, Delete Account)"] end subgraph Database ["Prisma ORM"] SQLite[("Local SQLite / Cloud PostgreSQL")] end subgraph External ["External LLM Providers"] Gemini["Google Gemini API"] OpenAI["OpenAI API"] Fallback["Built-in Smart Fallback Engine"] end Client --> UI UI --> RateLimit RateLimit --> AuthMid AuthMid --> Backend Backend --> Database ChatAPI --> Gemini ChatAPI --> OpenAI ChatAPI --> Fallback ``` --- ## Proposed Changes ### 1. Project Initialization & Dependencies - Scaffold Next.js 14/15 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, Prisma, bcryptjs, jose (JWT), and react-markdown. - Setup `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `postcss.config.js`, and `next.config.mjs` with strict security headers. #### [NEW] [package.json](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/package.json) #### [NEW] [tsconfig.json](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/tsconfig.json) #### [NEW] [tailwind.config.ts](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/tailwind.config.ts) #### [NEW] [next.config.mjs](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/next.config.mjs) #### [NEW] [.env.example](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/.env.example) --- ### 2. Database Layer (Prisma ORM) - Define relational schema: - `User`: Credentials, creation timestamp, cascade delete relations. - `UserSettings`: Persona/system instructions, preferred model, temperature, theme. - `Chat`: Title, timestamps, user ownership. - `Message`: Role (`user` | `assistant` | `system`), content, timestamps. - Prisma client singleton with connection pooling protection for Next.js hot-reloading. #### [NEW] [schema.prisma](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/prisma/schema.prisma) #### [NEW] [db.ts](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/lib/db.ts) --- ### 3. Authentication & Security Engine - Password hashing with `bcryptjs` (salt rounds: 12). - Stateless JWT issuance and verification using `jose` with `HS256`. - Secure cookie helpers (`HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict`, `Secure` in production, `Path=/`). - Sliding window in-memory rate limiting to prevent credential stuffing and API abuse. - Security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff). #### [NEW] [auth.ts](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/lib/auth.ts) #### [NEW] [rate-limit.ts](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/lib/rate-limit.ts) #### [NEW] [middleware.ts](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/middleware.ts) --- ### 4. Backend API Routes - **Authentication**: - `POST /api/auth/register`: Create account with username, email, password; auto-initialize default settings. - `POST /api/auth/login`: Authenticate and set HttpOnly JWT cookie. - `POST /api/auth/logout`: Clear auth cookie. - `GET /api/auth/me`: Get current authenticated user profile & settings. - **Chat Management**: - `GET /api/chats`: List user chats ordered by recent update with message counts. - `POST /api/chats`: Create a new chat session. - `GET /api/chats/[id]`: Retrieve full message history for a chat. - `PATCH /api/chats/[id]`: Rename chat title. - `DELETE /api/chats/[id]`: Delete specific chat. - **Chat Streaming**: - `POST /api/chat/stream`: Stream AI completion using server-side API keys (`GEMINI_API_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY`) with graceful fallback engine. Saves both user prompt and assistant response to database atomically. - **User Privacy & Data Rights**: - `GET /api/user/export`: Export complete user data (profile, settings, all chats and messages) in structured JSON format. - `DELETE /api/user/chats`: Delete all chats and message history for the user. - `DELETE /api/user/account`: Permanently delete user account and all associated data. - `PATCH /api/user/settings`: Update system prompt, model preference, temperature. #### [NEW] [route.ts (Register)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (Login)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (Logout)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/auth/logout/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (Me)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/auth/me/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (Chats)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/chats/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (Chat ID)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/chats/[id]/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (Chat Stream)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/chat/stream/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (User Data Export)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/user/export/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (User Account Delete)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/user/account/route.ts) #### [NEW] [route.ts (User Settings)](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/api/user/settings/route.ts) --- ### 5. Frontend Chat UI (ChatGPT-Style Experience) - **Design System & Theme**: - Dark mode by default (sleek ChatGPT gray `#202123` / `#343541` aesthetic) with smooth toggle for light mode. - **Sidebar Component**: - App logo: **UMGN** with subtitle "Personal AI". - "New chat" button with shortcut hint. - Chronological chat history groupings: *Today*, *Yesterday*, *Previous 7 Days*, *Older*. - Chat action popovers: Rename title, Delete conversation. - Responsive drawer toggle for smartphones and tablets. - User footer with avatar, username, and quick access to Settings Modal and Logout. - **Chat Viewport**: - Empty state with prompt suggestions (Coding, Writing, Analysis, Brainstorming). - Message stream with Markdown formatting, syntax highlighting, language badge, and one-click "Copy Code". - Assistant avatar with streaming cursor and "Stop generating" option. - Action buttons on messages (Copy message text, Regenerate). - Auto-resizing textarea with Enter-to-send and Shift+Enter for newlines. - **Settings Modal**: - **General**: Username display, Theme toggle (Dark / Light). - **Model & Persona**: System prompt customization, model selection, temperature slider. - **Data Controls & Privacy**: One-click "Export All Data (JSON)", "Clear All Chats", and danger-zone "Delete Account". - **Privacy Guarantee**: Visual badge confirming no unnecessary tracking or third-party telemetry. - **Auth Modals / Pages**: - Sleek Login & Registration view with input validation and error feedback. #### [NEW] [layout.tsx](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/layout.tsx) #### [NEW] [page.tsx](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/page.tsx) #### [NEW] [globals.css](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/app/globals.css) #### [NEW] [Sidebar.tsx](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/components/Sidebar.tsx) #### [NEW] [ChatArea.tsx](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/components/ChatArea.tsx) #### [NEW] [ChatMessage.tsx](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx) #### [NEW] [SettingsModal.tsx](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx) #### [NEW] [AuthModal.tsx](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/src/components/AuthModal.tsx) --- ### 6. Cloud & Production Readiness (Scalability & HTTPS) - Multi-stage `Dockerfile` optimized for standalone Next.js deployment. - `docker-compose.yml` configured with Caddy reverse proxy for automated Let's Encrypt SSL/HTTPS. - Production deployment guide (`DEPLOYMENT.md`) explaining how to host on cloud VPS (AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean, Hetzner) and scale from 10 users to 10,000+ users with PostgreSQL. #### [NEW] [Dockerfile](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/Dockerfile) #### [NEW] [docker-compose.yml](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/docker-compose.yml) #### [NEW] [Caddyfile](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/Caddyfile) #### [NEW] [DEPLOYMENT.md](file:///c:/Users/LENOVO/Documents/ud/DEPLOYMENT.md) --- ## Verification Plan ### Automated Tests & Checks 1. **TypeScript Compilation & Build Verification**: - Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to verify type safety across all components and API handlers. - Run `npm run build` to ensure the production bundle builds without errors. 2. **Database Migration Check**: - Run `npx prisma db push` or `npx prisma generate` to ensure SQLite schema initializes properly. 3. **API & Endpoints Verification**: - Test user registration with password hashing. - Test login and JWT cookie generation. - Test chat creation and message storage. - Test streaming chat endpoint (`/api/chat/stream`). - Test user data export (`/api/user/export`) and verify JSON output format. - Test chat deletion and account deletion cascade. ### Manual Verification 1. Launch development server (`npm run dev`) and test on desktop browser. 2. Test responsive mobile drawer on small viewport widths. 3. Verify dark mode aesthetic matches ChatGPT-style UI. 4. Verify code block formatting, copy buttons, and message streaming.

thinking: Defining the Prisma schema is the next step. The `User` model requires specific fields: a unique identifier, unique email and username, a password hash, timestamps for creation and updates, and relationships to `chats` and `settings` with cascade delete. These constraints ensure data integrity.

args.CodeContent:
datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

model User {
  id           String        @id @default(cuid())
  email        String        @unique
  username     String        @unique
  passwordHash String
  createdAt    DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime      @updatedAt

  chats        Chat[]
  settings     UserSettings?
}

model UserSettings {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String   @unique
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  systemPrompt String   @default("You are UMGN, a helpful, precise, and thoughtful AI assistant. Respond clearly and concisely.")
  model        String   @default("gemini-1.5-flash")
  temperature  Float    @default(0.7)
  theme        String   @default("dark")
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Chat {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  title     String    @default("New Chat")
  pinned    Boolean   @default(false)
  userId    String
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  messages  Message[]
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model Message {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  chatId    String
  chat      Chat     @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role      String   // "user" | "assistant" | "system"
  content   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}
